notes.title: Exciting Project Update
notes.content:
Hey all,

A quick update: This project was delayed due to some personal reasons (newborn baby in the family + covid19 happened) and I'm about to start the project back up again.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34916760/d38af84f774ccf77449351e3c4708fc606da7969.png[/img]

Quick Status:

* Recording video goes great
* Working on streamlining save process
* Adding basic edit features (VERY basic, things like image overlay, text, etc)
* Working on fine tuning audio
* Overall, the project is approx. 85% completed.

I'm in the process of hiring a C++/C# back-up programmer to help assist with the completion of everything and am super excited to move this project forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34916760/47225986bff8e0ec89bc76e322b9fbbdf1c9b36a.png[/img]

Thanks for checking out the app!

~StartupTim
